# XrealHeadTracker

**Inherits:** [`Node3D`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_node3d.html)  
**Registered by:** the `godot_xreal` GDExtension  

Scene node that drives its own transform from the native XREAL head pose each frame. Parent a `Camera3D` under it for a head-tracked view through the glasses.

It runs 6DoF by default, world-locking both rotation and position, and the tracking mode is selectable. It also emits the glasses hot-plug and hardware-input signals: `key_event`, `key_state_changed`, `wearing_changed`, `brightness_changed` and the rest. `is_tracking()` reports whether a native pose was applied on the last frame, and `recenter()` resets the forward direction. The current app `Camera3D` supplies its transform, clipping distances, FOV fallback, cull mask, environment, attributes and other render settings to both eye cameras at runtime; the SDK's calibrated per-eye projection and IPD still take precedence.

## Signals

<a id="signal-brightness_changed"></a>

### brightness_changed(level: int)

The glasses brightness level changed, from the brightness rocker or the system UI.

<a id="signal-display_started"></a>

### display_started()

Emitted once when the glasses display and head tracking first go live, on the first frame a head pose arrives. Connect it in GDScript and call `recenter()` to make the current head direction "forward" at startup.

<a id="signal-ec_level_changed"></a>

### ec_level_changed(level: int)

The electrochromic dimming level changed. One Pro only.

<a id="signal-glasses_connected"></a>

### glasses_connected()

Emitted when the XREAL glasses display is plugged in at runtime, on `onDisplayAdded`. It fires even when the app started with the glasses disconnected: the native session bootstrap then retries `CreateSession`, and `display_started` follows once tracking comes up.

<a id="signal-glasses_disconnected"></a>

### glasses_disconnected()

Emitted when the XREAL glasses display is unplugged at runtime (`onDisplayRemoved`).

<a id="signal-glasses_event"></a>

### glasses_event(action_type: int, para: int, para2: int, para3: float)

Catch-all for every native glasses event, including the types without a dedicated signal, such as temperature, screen on and off, and the disconnect reason. The values are the raw `GlassesEventData` fields; see `XREALActionType` in `docs/develop/plans/input-plan.md`.

<a id="signal-key_event"></a>

### key_event(key: int, action: int)

A physical key on the glasses was clicked. `key` is one of the `KEY_*` constants, MULTI, INCREASE, DECREASE or MENU, and `action` is `ACTION_CLICK`, `ACTION_DOUBLE_CLICK` or `ACTION_LONG_PRESS`.

<a id="signal-key_state_changed"></a>

### key_state_changed(key: int, state: int)

Raw down or up transition of a physical key: `state` is `KEY_STATE_DOWN` or `KEY_STATE_UP`.

<a id="signal-volume_changed"></a>

### volume_changed(level: int)

The glasses volume level changed.

<a id="signal-wearing_changed"></a>

### wearing_changed(wearing: bool)

The proximity (wear) sensor reported the glasses were put on (`true`) or taken off.

## Methods

<a id="method-debug_pose_text"></a>

### debug_pose_text() -> String

Latest raw and converted pose sample for visual on-device debugging.

<a id="method-get_current_render_scale"></a>

### get_current_render_scale() -> float

Current per-eye render scale after any dynamic adjustment. Returns the configured ceiling before the stereo rig is created.

<a id="method-is_tracking"></a>

### is_tracking() -> bool

Whether native head tracking fed a pose on the last frame.

<a id="method-recenter"></a>

### recenter()

Re-center the view so the current head direction becomes "forward".

## Constants

| Constant | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="constant-KEY_MULTI"></a>`KEY_MULTI` | `1` | `key` value in `key_event` and `key_state_changed`, an `XREALKeyType`: the MULTI, or function, key. |
| <a id="constant-KEY_INCREASE"></a>`KEY_INCREASE` | `2` | `key` value: the brightness and volume INCREASE key. |
| <a id="constant-KEY_DECREASE"></a>`KEY_DECREASE` | `3` | `key` value: the brightness and volume DECREASE key. |
| <a id="constant-KEY_MENU"></a>`KEY_MENU` | `4` | `key` value: the MENU key. |
| <a id="constant-ACTION_CLICK"></a>`ACTION_CLICK` | `1` | `action` value in `key_event`, an `XREALClickType`: a single click. |
| <a id="constant-ACTION_DOUBLE_CLICK"></a>`ACTION_DOUBLE_CLICK` | `2` | `action` value in `key_event`: a double click. |
| <a id="constant-ACTION_LONG_PRESS"></a>`ACTION_LONG_PRESS` | `3` | `action` value in `key_event`: a long press. |
| <a id="constant-KEY_STATE_DOWN"></a>`KEY_STATE_DOWN` | `1` | `state` value in `key_state_changed`, an `XREALKeyState`: the key went down. |
| <a id="constant-KEY_STATE_UP"></a>`KEY_STATE_UP` | `2` | `state` value in `key_state_changed`: the key was released. |
